description: Ordinary concatenation keeps every pause contribution, including adjacent pauses and pauses at either end. A child's verbatim image preserves its internal periods independently of the value channel (engine §11.2).

documents.g.md:
```jbogenbau
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text [{part}]
%rule part v | pause | y
%rule v :- $.verbatim-text | ("a" "." "." "b") %emits $ :: V


%rule pause "-" %emits $ :: (P ∪ Sound-002E-s) := "." :- " "

%rule y "y" %emits $ :: (Y ∪ Sound-0079-s) := "y"

```
